Vietnamese_Text: Thôi kệ đi, không sao đâu.

English_Text: I’m knackered today, so fed up.
So good — that really hit the spot!
Fancy going for a drink tonight?

Vietnamese_Text: U là trời, đẹp dữ vậy!
Đồ xịn đó, không phải hàng dỏm.
English_Text: That’s the real thing, not a knock-off.
Let’s go all the way with it.
I’ve been grafting hard this month.

Vietnamese_Text: Cháy túi rồi, tháng sau đi.
English_Text: I’m skint — let’s go next month.

Vietnamese_Text: Mua hớ rồi, chỗ kia rẻ hơn.
English_Text: I got done — it’s cheaper over there.

Vietnamese_Text: Của chùa mà, cứ ăn đi.
English_Text: It’s free, go on and eat.
Sit and have a natter a minute.

Vietnamese_Text: Gato gì mà gato dữ vậy.
English_Text: What are you so jealous about?
He’s flirting with the whole neighbourhood.

Vietnamese_Text: Nhắn hoài mà nó bơ luôn.
English_Text: I keep texting and he just blanks me.

Vietnamese_Text: Hôm qua nó xỉn quắc cần câu.
English_Text: He was absolutely hammered last night.
He went in hard on that.

Vietnamese_Text: Chỗ đó chặt chém dữ lắm, đừng vô.
English_Text: That place rips you off, don’t go in.
Steady on with the tall tales.

Vietnamese_Text: Nó nổ dữ lắm, đừng tin.
English_Text: He talks himself right up, don’t believe it.

Vietnamese_Text: Nó bị bóc phốt trên mạng rồi.
Mấy đứa trẻ trâu đó ồn quá.
English_Text: Those kids acting big are too loud.

Vietnamese_Text: Im đi, để người ta nói.
English_Text: Be quiet and let them speak.
Knock it off, I haven’t got time.
That’s enough now, I mean it.
that’s enough now — the warning before it escalates

Vietnamese_Text: Đồ ngu, làm sai hết rồi.
English_Text: You idiot, you’ve got it all wrong.

Vietnamese_Text: Ăn hại, chẳng làm gì cả.
Ngu như bò, nói hoài không hiểu.
English_Text: Thick as an ox — told him a hundred times.

Vietnamese_Text: Đồ mặt dày, không biết ngại.
English_Text: Shameless — hasn’t got an ounce of embarrassment.

Vietnamese_Text: Ông già đó dê lắm, tránh ra.
English_Text: That old man is letchy, keep away.
